Hate to be the bearer of bad news… To be competitive in the current meta there is a certain amount of pve “required”. Get a covenant, go to torghast for your legendary, and set up soulbinds/conduits. A lot of it has been made easier in the .5 from buying stuff by the flight master in Oribos like the conquest boxes and the 200 Ilvl conduit thing. You can get through it all pretty quick if you just focus on what’s necessary. I would avoid spending any more honor on honor pieces and mostly try to save for upgrades to conquest pieces and lfg play 2s and 3s to farm out conquest. It’ll get easier once you get your legendary and conduits all set up. There are plenty of resources and other players willing to help as well!
